fy_label_note: Baba/Visible Alpha FY-YYYY = Adient fiscal year ending September YYYY (FY-2025 revenue $14,535M matches company FY2025). Window FY2021 to FY2026; FY2026 (ended 2026-09-30, not yet reported) is still a VA estimate (Q1, Q2 actual, Q3, Q4 estimated). VA EBITDA excludes equity income and runs below company adjusted EBITDA (VA FY2026 $793M vs company guide about $885M), so all margins here are VA basis for both company and peers. Peers: LEA, MGA, THRM, FRVIA are calendar years; Toyota Boshoku (3116) and TS Tech (7313) are March fiscal years under VA labels, so roughly a one-quarter offset. Longer context outside the window: VA EBITDA margin was 6.78% in FY2017.

company.ltm_source: Stage 3 record quant.ebitda_margin_ltm (Baba ltm_ebitda dataset); company-reported Q3 FY2026 adjusted EBITDA margin 5.7% (doc 129577)

peers.notes: Seating and interiors peers from the Baba Auto Parts comps (85 names). Median of six = mean of 3rd and 4th ranked (LEA and MGA in both years). FY2021 median uses five peers (TS Tech history starts FY2022). Forvia VA revenue series is discontinuous (FY2023 $30.1B, FY2024 $22.7B), so its margin is used with caution; removing it does not change the sign. Negative median decline means the peer median rose.

deciding_facts: Over FY2025 to FY2026E the peer median EBITDA margin rose 57 bps (8.24% to 8.81%) while Adient fell 30 bps (5.57% to 5.28%) on revenue up 3.4%, so the ratio is negative (-1.94) and the gap to peers widened from -266 to -353 bps.

Management itself attributes most of the compression to mix (60 of 70 bps in Q2 FY2026, the deliberate pivot to Chinese local OEMs) rather than volume; the Middle East cost and EMEA volume headwinds are real but external drivers did not hit peers' medians the same way.
confidence_note: The company decline is only 30 bps on a mostly estimated FY2026, so the ratio is unstable; the classification rests as much on the widened relative gap and rising revenue as on the ratio. Mix is partly strategic choice (China local-OEM wins), not operational failure.
